args.sql: SELECT age_count FROM demographics WHERE contrib_registry = 'D812743';

SELECT 
    tm.match_rec_registry,
    tm.donor_ref_reg,
    tm.recip_ref_reg,
    rd.age_count AS recipient_age,
    CAST(SPLIT_PART(d.age_count, ' ', 1) AS smallint) AS donor_age,
    ABS(rd.age_count - CAST(SPLIT_PART(d.age_count, ' ', 1) AS smallint)) AS age_diff
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN recipients_demographics rd ON tm.recip_ref_reg = rd.recip_registry
JOIN demographics d ON tm.donor_ref_reg = d.contrib_registry
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed'
ORDER BY age_diff DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ABS(rd.age_count - CAST(SPLIT_PART(d.age_count, ' ', 1) AS smallint)) AS age_diff
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN recipients_demographics rd ON tm.recip_ref_reg = rd.recip_registry
JOIN demographics d ON tm.donor_ref_reg = d.contrib_registry
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed';

SELECT MAX(ABS(rd.age_count - CAST(SPLIT_PART(d.age_count, ' ', 1) AS smallint))) AS max_age_diff
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN recipients_demographics rd ON tm.recip_ref_reg = rd.recip_registry
JOIN demographics d ON tm.donor_ref_reg = d.contrib_registry
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed';
